label: Whatever CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustains every other thing is present to each whenever it is
paraphrase: In every history of the model, whatever is a CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause of every other thing present at some moment is, at every moment at which another thing is present, present itself and giving that thing being (PresentToAllWheneverTheyAre). Derived from the contact principle alone. It types the q.8 a.1 presence of an agent to that on which it acts, not place, containment, the other modes of presence, or immediacy.
